messages.subject: Issue with multispecies Occu model
parts:
Hello all,

I'm having issues conducting a multi-species occu model. 

1) I cannot get the site covs in the umf file without an error

2) when I run the umf with siteCovs = Null, the umf runs, but then I get this error when trying to run a model.

Prints of screens with errors and code are below.

Some fake data is attached for each of 3 species and 2 siteCovs.

Can anyone help?

Thanks,

Sarah

> pesu<-read.csv("pesu fake summ 2021.csv", header=TRUE)

> laci<-read.csv("laci fake summ 2021.csv", header=TRUE)

> myve<-read.csv("myve fake summ 2021.csv", header=TRUE)

> dim(sc)

[1] 59  2

> sitecovs<-read.csv("site covs fake summ 2021.csv", header=TRUE)

> y <- list(matrix(pesu), matrix(laci), matrix(myve)) # species 3

> siteCovs <- data.frame(sitecovs[,2:3])

> umf <- unmarkedFrameOccuMulti(y=y, siteCovs=siteCovs,

+                               obsCovs=NULL) # organize data

Error in validObject(.Object) :

  invalid class “unmarkedFrameOccuMulti” object: siteCovData does not have same size number of sites as y

> umf <- unmarkedFrameOccuMulti(y=y, siteCovs=NULL,

+                               obsCovs=NULL) # organize data

>  # summarize

>  # visualize

> fm <- occu(~1 ~1, umf) # fit a model

Error in occu(~1 ~ 1, umf) : Data is not an unmarkedFrameOccu object.

messages.subject: Re: Issue with multispecies Occu model
parts:
Hope this helps.

# Load library
  library(unmarked)

# Get count data
  pesu <- read.csv("pesu fake summ 2021.csv", header=TRUE)
  laci <- read.csv("laci fake summ 2021.csv", header=TRUE)
  myve <- read.csv("myve fake summ 2021.csv", header=TRUE)

# Put counts into the "y" list: 2:9 is used to
  y <- list(pesu=as.matrix(pesu[, -1]), laci=as.matrix(laci[, -1]),
            myve=as.matrix(myve[, -1]))

# Site covariates
  sitecovs <- read.csv("site covs fake summ 2021.csv", header=TRUE)
  siteCovs <- data.frame(sitecovs[,2:3])  # watch out for mixing up variable
                                          # names that differ only on the case
                                          # of one letter!

# occu modeling  (separate models for each species)
  umf.pesu <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=y$pesu, siteCovs=siteCovs)
  umf.laci <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=y$laci, siteCovs=siteCovs)
  umf.myve <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=y$myve, siteCovs=siteCovs)
  fm.pesu <- occu(~1 ~1, umf.pesu)
  fm.laci <- occu(~1 ~1, umf.laci)
  fm.myve <- occu(~1 ~1, umf.myve)
 
# occuMulti modeling (one model for all species)
  umf <- unmarkedFrameOccuMulti(y=y, siteCovs=siteCovs)
  # of columns in umf@fDesign = # of columns in occFormulas
  dim(umf@fDesign)[2]
  # 7
  occFormulas <- c('~1', '~var1', '~var1 + var2', '~1', '~1', '~1','~1')
    detFormulas <- c('~1', '~1', '~1')
  fit <- occuMulti(detFormulas, occFormulas, umf)
  

Jim
